title: 도커를 사용한 파이썬 프로젝트 구축
markdown: ```bash FROM python:3.11-slim WORKDIR /app COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt COPY . . CMD ["python", "main.py"] ``` ```bash docker build -t my-python-app . docker run --rm my-python-app ```
